newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar and Germany sign an air transport accord.
newsitem.headline: Qatar and Germany sign an air transport accord.

text.p: Qatar and Germany have signed an air transport accord allowing the national carriers of each country to operate four weekly flights to the other, the English- language Gulf Times newspaper reported on Sunday.
Under the accord, which was signed on Saturday, Qatar Airways and Gulf Air are regarded as Qatar's national carriers and Lufthansa as Germany's national carrier.
A total of four weekly flights into Germany can be operated by Qatar Airways and Gulf Air. Lufthansa can operate the same number to Doha.
The newspaper said the accord lifts restrictions on the type of aircraft for flights to the respective destinations and allows for custom duties exemptions on spare parts.
The Bahrain-based Gulf Air is owned by the governments of Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, and United Arab Emirates member Abu Dhabi.
